name: Acetylcarnitine
aliases: O-acetylcarnitine, O-acetyl-L-carnitine, acetyl-L-carnitine, (R)-acetylcarnitine, acetyl-L-(-)-carnitine, ALCAR, L-acetylcarnitine, L-carnitine acetyl ester
summary: Acetyl-L-carnitine (ALCAR or ALC), also known as levacecarnine, is an acetylated form of L-carnitine. It is naturally produced by the human body, and it is available as a dietary supplement. Acetylcarnitine is broken down in the blood by plasma esterases to carnitine which is used by the body to transport fatty acids into the mitochondria for breakdown and energy production.
zhOther: 乙醯左旋肉鹼, 乙酰左旋肉碱
zhHansOther: 乙醯左旋肉鹼, 乙酰左旋肉碱
summaryZh: 乙醯左式肉鹼是左式肉鹼的一種酯化物，也是一種常見的食品添加劑。廣泛存在於植物和動物組織中。
summaryZhHans: 乙酰左式肉碱是左式肉碱的一种酯化物，也是一种常见的食品添加剂。广泛存在于植物和动物组织中。

pharmacology.en: In the blood, enzymes strip off its acetyl group to give carnitine, which carries fatty acids into mitochondria so they can be used for energy.
pharmacology.zh: 在血液中，酵素會把它的乙醯基移除而生成肉鹼，而肉鹼負責把脂肪酸運進線粒體，供細胞產生能量。
pharmacology.zhHans: 在血液中，酵素会把它的乙酰基移除而生成肉碱，而肉碱负责把脂肪酸运进线粒体，供细胞产生能量。

uses.en: It is sold as a dietary supplement and has been studied for nerve pain and age-related memory problems.
uses.zh: 它作為膳食補充品販售，也曾被研究用於神經疼痛與與年齡相關的記憶問題。
uses.zhHans: 它作为膳食补充品贩售，也曾被研究用于神经疼痛与与年龄相关的记忆问题。

sideEffects.en: It commonly causes nausea, stomach upset and a fishy body odour. Restlessness and trouble sleeping have also been reported.
sideEffects.zh: 它常引起噁心、腸胃不適與體味帶有魚腥味。也有躁動不安與睡眠困難的報告。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它常引起恶心、肠胃不适与体味带有鱼腥味。也有躁动不安与睡眠困难的报告。

fact.en: Carnitine takes its name from the Latin carnis, meaning flesh, because it was first isolated from muscle tissue in 1905. Its job is to carry fats into mitochondria to be burned for energy.
fact.zh: 肉鹼（carnitine）的名稱來自拉丁文「carnis」（肉），因為它最早是1905年從肌肉組織中分離出來的。它的工作是把脂肪運進線粒體燃燒產生能量。
fact.zhHans: 肉碱（carnitine）的名称来自拉丁文「carnis」（肉），因为它最早是1905年从肌肉组织中分离出来的。它的工作是把脂肪运进线粒体燃烧产生能量。
